role: Page template for the code-map report: tabs for Overview, Flowcharts, Findings, Every unit, Orphaned & unreachable, Coupling, Strings, Method & limits, with the scripts that load data/*.json on demand.
state: localStorage pm-tab (last open tab, per viewer)
toplevel: Static HTML/CSS with {{placeholders}} that report.build fills (counts, the high-severity table, the area table, finding-kind chips, Mermaid chart sources, dead types). Inline script: tab switching (also by #hash), findings filters with paging by 200, the unit explorer (area -> file -> units with calls, certain callers, possible callers (collapsed; the name matches more than one unit), state, branches and findings; links jump between units), unreachable and shared-state tables, and the string audit. Theme-aware colours; fonts from Google Fonts with system fallbacks.
